questions.question: Convert 4 2/5 to an improper fraction and 29/6 to a mixed number, explaining the method.
Simplify 36/48 using the HCF and explain why the value does not change.
questions.expected_answer: The HCF of 36 and 48 is 12; dividing both by 12 gives 3/4. Dividing numerator and denominator by the same number is dividing by one, so the value is unchanged.

questions.question: Show how cancelling makes 14/15 × 25/21 easy, and give the answer.
questions.expected_answer: Cancel 7 between 14 and 21, and 5 between 25 and 15, leaving 2/3 × 5/3 = 10/9.
